versions.name: Camp Pomperaug
versions.summary: A Connecticut Yankee Council forest property in Union, Connecticut, near the Massachusetts border, encompassing Wells Pond and access to Lake Mashapaug. The council owns the land but has leased it to a burn-care foundation, so Scout units cannot currently camp on the site.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from Connecticut Yankee Council sources. The slice mislabeled the city as Woodbury; the property is in Union, CT and is owned by the council but leased to a burn-care foundation with no Scout program on site, so it is recorded as not_operating. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: council ownership verified; property is leased out and runs no Scout program, hence not_operating; camp_type classified conservatively; features unsurveyed.
